about: Owner directive 2026-11-10 (docs/directives/2026-11-10_github_actions_testing.md): targeted Tests runs by subsystem. tests.yml input 'group' takes one or more of these names (space-separated); a suite runs when its path matches any of the group's regular expressions. A targeted run uses one runner and skips the Python checks and the 10-day economy run (they belong to the full run). The full run (no group, no only) stays the integration gate. A suite may sit in several groups; a suite in none runs only in the full run.
